author: JayzTwoCents
description:
Windows collects a LOT more data than most people realize — and most of it is enabled by default. In this video, I’ll show you exactly how to stop Windows from spying on you by disabling telemetry, tracking, background data collection, and hidden privacy-invading settings buried deep inside Windows 10 and Windows 11.

This is a complete, step-by-step privacy guide covering the exact settings Microsoft doesn’t make obvious — including diagnostic tracking, activity history, advertising ID, background apps, location tracking, and more.

Whether you want maximum privacy, better performance, or just full control over your system, these are the essential settings every Windows user should change immediately.

What you’ll learn:
• How to disable Windows telemetry
• How to turn off hidden tracking settings
• How to stop background data collection
• How to lock down privacy in Windows 10 & 11
• The biggest privacy mistakes most users make

title: How to give Microsoft the Middle Finger and take back your Privacy!
